verdicts.reason: A shrinks all the type, so the headline, CTA and the small SOLSTICE wordmark are undersized for the canvas. A bokeh dot sits on the 'E' of SOLSTICE, and the content is packed into the upper middle while the lower third is left empty. B keeps the type and logo at a sensible size and spreads logo, headline and CTA down the taller format with clear hierarchy. Its flaws are minor: the headline sits below the centre of the glow, and a dot sits close to the end of the CTA.
